name: Roast Beef "Caesar" Wrap with Roasted Pepper-Arugula Salad & Parmesan
ingredients: 1 (12 oz) jar roasted red bell peppers
instructions: Wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the arugula.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Add to the bowl, along with cheese and dressing, then toss to combine the salad.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide roast beef between them. Top with a portion of the salad and roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
To serve, divide wraps and remaining salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
